items.title: Jameson Williams: Retains modest role in loss
items.body_text: Williams brought in two of four targets for 33 yards in the Lions' 41-31 loss to the Bills on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam LaPorta: Scores first TD of '26 in loss
items.body_text: LaPorta brought in six of seven targets for 52 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 41-31 loss to the Bills on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dalton Kincaid: Continues explosive start to season Thursday
items.body_text: Kincaid brought in seven of eight targets for 95 yards and a touchdown in the Bills' 41-31 win over the Lions on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jared Goff: Racks up production in high-scoring loss
items.body_text: Goff completed 26 of 38 passes for 327 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions while adding three rushes for seven yards in the Lions' 41-31 loss to the Bills on Thursday. He also committed two fumbles, losing one. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown: Stellar numbers in Week 2 loss
items.body_text: St. Brown brought in nine of 13 targets for 142 yards and two touchdowns in the Lions' 41-31 loss to the Bills on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
